name: What is the typical cost to build an ADU in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to build an ADU in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building an ADU in Los Angeles can vary significantly based on size, type, materials, and site conditions. Generally, a garage conversion might range from $80,000 to $150,000, while a new detached ADU can cost anywhere from $150,000 to over $300,000. These figures include design, permits, and construction. Factors like extensive utility trenching, hillside construction, or luxury finishes will increase the overall investment. It's essential to get a detailed quote tailored to your specific project and property.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU costs in Los Angeles vary widely. Garage conversions typically range from $80,000-$150,000, while new detached units can be $150,000-$300,000+, depending on project specifics.
